title: hearty canadian lentils bake
description: a post-workout, springy, yeasty, and nutritious dish featuring brown lentils, perfect for a quick and easy weeknight meal.
instructions: in a large bowl, combine the brown lentils, coconut oil, onion, garlic, wood-fired salt, and black pepper.
place the banana leaf on a flat surface and arrange the lentil mixture in the center of the leaf.
gently fold the edges of the leaf over the lentil mixture to create a tight seal.
place the leaf packet on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes.
meanwhile, prepare the nutritional yeast mixture by combining the nutritional yeast and water in a small bowl.
after 30 minutes of baking, carefully remove the leaf packet from the oven and brush the nutritional yeast mixture evenly over the top.
return the leaf packet to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
